--Petitioner
 Versus

--Respondents
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Anup Kumar Verma, Advocate for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Sushil Vashishtha, Standing 
Counsel for the State.
3. The petitioner has sought her transfer 
from Almora to Nainital who is Assistant 
Teacher in Primary School has filed the 
present writ petition for intra district 
transfer from Almora to District Nainital.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for 
the petitioner that pursuant to the order 
passed by Secretary of the department, the 
petitioner has prescribed her option and 
given the same to the Director, Elementary 
Education on 16.06.2025. Learned counsel 
for the petitioner says that in the said 
option, till date, no decision has been taken 
and the matter is pending.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for the 
State submits that as per the counter 
affidavit filed by the State, the matter is 
under consideration with the State 
Government. Learned counsel for the State 
shall take instructions in the matter within 
three days.
6. List this case on 28.07.2026 
immediately after fresh.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
